caption:
A little light. A little texture. A moment worth keeping.

A visual study of the morning coffee ritual, from the first bean to the final pause.

Fieldwork Coffee is a fictional example brand from VIRAX Engine Machine.

scenes.evidence: One cup of black coffee and a linen cloth in morning light.
scenes.composition: Warm architectural still life on a terracotta plinth.
scenes.alt: An ivory cup of black coffee and a linen cloth on a terracotta plinth, with long morning shadows.

scenes.message: Look closely at the raw texture.
scenes.evidence: Visible grooves and irregular surfaces on roasted coffee beans.
scenes.composition: Macro view of beans in a steel scoop with a coral background.
scenes.alt: A close view of roasted coffee beans in a brushed steel scoop against a coral background.

scenes.message: Show three visually different ground textures.
scenes.evidence: Three separate piles with coarse, medium, and fine particles.
scenes.composition: Overhead comparison on ivory paper with a small spoon.
scenes.alt: Three separate piles of coffee grounds with visibly different particle sizes on ivory paper.

scenes.message: Introduce the water and the glass.
scenes.evidence: A narrow stream enters the transparent glass carafe.
scenes.composition: A cropped kettle spout above a glass carafe against pale green.
scenes.alt: A steel gooseneck kettle pours clear water into a glass carafe against a pale green background.

scenes.message: Give the filter its own moment.
scenes.evidence: The conical paper filter rests inside a ridged ceramic dripper.
scenes.composition: Close view above a clear carafe on coral tiles.
scenes.alt: A damp paper filter sits in an ivory ceramic coffee dripper above a clear glass carafe.

scenes.message: Show the active texture of the brew.
scenes.evidence: Wet grounds and small visible bubbles inside a paper filter.
scenes.composition: Close overhead view of a stream of water entering coffee grounds.
scenes.alt: A close view of water entering wet coffee grounds, with bubbles on the surface inside a paper filter.

scenes.message: Follow the coffee into the carafe.
scenes.evidence: Coffee droplets fall from the dripper into the glass vessel.
scenes.composition: Side view with sunlight through the dark coffee.
scenes.alt: Coffee drops fall from an ivory dripper into a glass carafe, with sunlight through the brown coffee.

scenes.message: Move from preparation to a shared pause.
scenes.evidence: Two cups, one closed book, and a café table.
scenes.composition: Afternoon shadows across a terracotta table, without people.
scenes.alt: Two ivory cups of black coffee and a closed book sit on a terracotta café table in afternoon light.

scenes.message: Finish with one deliberate still life.
scenes.evidence: A cup, linen cloth, and bowl of beans form a complete arrangement.
scenes.composition: Balanced objects on a coral pedestal against pale lime.
scenes.alt: An ivory cup of coffee, folded linen, and a small bowl of beans on a coral pedestal against pale lime.

sourceRecord.classification: Original visual showcase; no technical or business claims.
